examples.en: Ted hated parties, even gatherings of people he liked individually.
examples.zh: 特德讨厌聚会，即便是聚会上的每一个人他都喜欢。

examples.en: He spends his time making speeches at factories or gatherings of the Party faithful.
examples.zh: 他花时间在工厂或者在该党忠实拥护者的集会上发表演讲。

examples.en: I mentioned my grandmother's childhood, how much her parents love music, how she played the piano at all our family gatherings.
examples.zh: 我提到了我祖母的童年，她的父母多么热爱音乐，以及她是怎样在我们所有的家庭聚会上弹钢琴的。
